 2027 Non-Profit Recreation Grant
        Announcement


Applications will be available August 3 – September 18, 2026 for non-profit and
those formally sponsored by qualifying non-profit organizations seeking grant
funding for recreation related projects to be offered in 2027. Qualifying organizations
must operate within the Girdwood Valley Service Area (GVSA). Funding is contingent
on municipal approval of the GBOS 2027 Operating Budget.

GBOS is setting aside $65,000 in grant funding to be split among those requesting
and qualifying for non-profit recreation grants.

Information & applications are available at the Girdwood Post Office, Gerrish Library,
Girdwood Parks and Rec Office bulletin boards and on-line at www.muni.org/gbos
August 3 thru September 18.

The deadline for submission is Friday, September 18, 2026 by 3pm. Late applications
will not be accepted.

If you have questions, please contact Margaret Tyler, 907-343-8373,
tylerms@muni.org.
